## Access-Review Campaign: Full API Flow

All calls use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Base URL pattern: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`.

---

### Step 0 — Authenticate (OAuth2 client-credentials)

```http
POST /oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id=<PAT_client_id>
&client_secret=<PAT_client_secret>
```

Returns `access_token`. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every subsequent call.

---

### Step 1 — Create the Campaign

```http
POST /v3/campaigns
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Q3 2026 Manager Access Review",
  "description": "Quarterly review of manager-owned entitlements",
  "type": "MANAGER",
  "deadline": "2026-09-30T23:59:59.999Z",
  "emailNotificationEnabled": true,
  "recommendationsEnabled": true,
  "mandatoryCommentRequirement": "REVOKE_ONLY"
}
```

**Required fields:** `name`, `description`, `type`

`type` options: `MANAGER`, `SOURCE_OWNER`, `SEARCH`, `ROLE_COMPOSITION`

The response includes the campaign `id` and `status: "STAGED"`. The campaign is staged (reviewers can be previewed) but not yet running.

---

### Step 2 — Activate (Start) the Campaign

The campaign must be in `STAGED` status before this call.

```http
POST /v3/campaigns/{id}/activate
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "timeZone": "America/New_York"
}
```

`timeZone` is optional. The response is a `202 Accepted` — activation is asynchronous. Campaign `status` transitions to `ACTIVE` once processing completes.

---

### Step 3 — Check Campaign Status

Poll the campaign list with a filter to confirm it's active:

```http
GET /v3/campaigns?filters=id+eq+%22{id}%22
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

Look for `"status": "ACTIVE"` in the response before pulling results.

---

### Step 4 — Pull Results

**Option A — List available reports** (metadata + download links for previously generated reports):

```http
GET /v3/campaigns/{id}/reports
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Option B — Trigger a fresh report** (async, then re-call the GET above for the download URL):

```http
POST /v3/campaigns/{id}/run-report/{type}
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

`{type}` values:
| Type | What it contains |
|---|---|
| `CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION` | All reviewers + their items |
| `CAMPAIGN_REMEDIATION_STATUS` | Revoke vs. approve counts |
| `CAMPAIGN_DECISION` | All decisions made so far (approve/revoke + comments) |

After triggering, re-call `GET /v3/campaigns/{id}/reports` and follow the returned `downloadUrl` to fetch the CSV/JSON report.

---

### Scopes Required

| Endpoint | Required scope |
|---|---|
| POST /v3/campaigns | `idn:campaign:manage` |
| POST /v3/campaigns/{id}/activate | `idn:campaign:manage` |
| GET /v3/campaigns | `idn:campaign:read` or `idn:campaign:manage` |
| GET /v3/campaigns/{id}/reports | `idn:campaign-report:read` or `idn:campaign-report:manage` |
| POST /v3/campaigns/{id}/run-report/{type} | `idn:campaign-report:manage` |

Required user level: `ORG_ADMIN` or `CERT_ADMIN`.

---
